title: The Hawking Singularity Theorem for Hölder Continuous Metrics with $L^p$-Bounded Curvature
summary: We prove a low-regularity version of Hawking's singularity theorem for Lorentzian metrics in $W^{1,p}$ with Riemann curvature in $L^p$, where $p>2n$ and $n$ the dimension of spacetime. This extends previous results beyond the Lipschitz regime. Under suitable lower Ricci bounds and upper mean curvature assumptions, expressed in terms of temporal functions, we establish both the globally hyperbolic version of Hawking's theorem, in the form of an upper bound on the time separation from a spacelike Cauchy hypersurface, and the version with a compact achronal spacelike hypersurface, yielding…
